verdict.rationale: Bruno's design keeps user data out of AI training. It is offline-only with no cloud sync or account, and the vendor states it is "not training AI models on your data". Bruno AI uses a Bring Your Own Key model with no data routed through Bruno servers, and it can point at local models such as Ollama or LM Studio, so data can stay entirely on-device. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training and no-routing claims.
